weapon.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Def+5 and bonus to Atk/Def during combat = current bonus on unit's Atk/Def. Calculates each stat bonus independently.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

b.d: If Sing or Dance is used, inflicts Atk-3 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of unit through their next actions.
If Sing or Dance is used, inflicts Atk-5 on nearest foes within 4 spaces of unit through their next actions.

c.d: If unit's HP = 100%, infantry and armored allies within 2 spaces can move to a space adjacent to unit.
If unit's HP ≥ 50%, infantry and armored allies within 2 spaces can move to a space adjacent to unit.
Infantry and armored allies within 2 spaces can move to a space adjacent to unit.
